findings: All gates except aggregate expiry pass. Both native segments complete without prediction failures or horizon pauses.
The sole expiry is actor 234 epoch 4, applied sequence 2, soon after entering the frame profile. Its next intervals are locally enqueued but acknowledged after the epoch reset.
The client request window reaches eight pending requests during recovery. Periodic reads compete with subsequent frame bursts while the producer waits for verified credit.
limitations: One 120-second run is not an isolated causal comparison or a soak.
No own compiler ran during measurement; the host is shared.
Only the headless producer changed; no native-client improvement is inferred.
Enqueue timestamps do not establish socket-write or authority-admission timing.
Offscreen rendering does not measure physical input-to-display latency.
